title: Principal Investigator, Whale Watch Lab
verdict_why: No out-of-sample edge and the regime rarely speaks (decisive only 0.0% of cycles). A signal that rarely speaks and never beats the baseline is not a signal — I recommend weight 0 and the ledger records the refutation.
verdict_plain: Wendy's verdict: the evidence says whale flow carries no usable signal. She recommends removing it from the model entirely — a negative result, published honestly.
model_gates: APPLY_CANDIDATE nominates only. Adoption requires the runner's champion/challenger gates: held-out Brier improvement ≥ 2e-4, positive in both halves, family-wise α=0.05 with Bonferroni correction, ≥24h between adoptions. WITHDRAW recommends onchainWeight 0. This file never changes a weight directly.

disciplines_applied.assessment: The ledger is mostly quiet (0.0% decisive). I do not mistake exchange housekeeping for economic flow, and I do not narrate silence.

Flow is defined by its window and watchlist — 24h and 7d reference points against per-cycle snapshots. Change the window and the number changes, so the window is part of the result. Flow accounting is an identity, not a model.
No edge to explain — I will not invent a microstructure story for a statistic that is not there.

Exchange wallets are hubs with unmistakable degree signatures; I separate hub-to-periphery economic movement from hub-to-hub internal plumbing. One edge is an anecdote; a pattern of edges is evidence.
decisive_frac=0.0% over n=200; no out-of-sample edge — the scoreboard overrules the ledger bench. Whale events are rare — I size my claims to my sample.
A signal that rarely speaks and never beats the baseline is not a signal — the risk-managed move is to withdraw, not to keep a dead hypothesis on life support.
Pipeline healthy: ledger reachable 100.0% of cycles; watchlist labels verified, never guessed; same ledger state reproduces the same numbers.

A whale alert is not a trade signal — by the time a 10M XRP transfer confirms on-ledger, the market has often already priced it. The edge, if any, is in quiet accumulation, not the splash. That is why no APPLY verdict of mine ever skips out-of-sample proof.
Known: 0.0% decisive reads over 200 cycles, 0 whale-pulse cycles. Unknown: whether whales change behavior once watched. Confidence: moderate — evidence-backed, still falsifiable.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; nothing was buried and nothing was accepted without a test.
I sign this verdict: WITHDRAW. It is defensible from the record below, and I will reverse it the moment the evidence does.
